To spread blessings — acts of kindness, compassion, and love — through a network of blessors graciously donating their time, treasures, and talent.

QORVAL Partners is a United States (Florida)-based business consulting and advisory firm providing growth, transformation, exit advisory and interim C-level services, founded in 1996 by business transformation expert and six-time Fortune 500 CEO, James R. “Jim” Malone, (1942-2021). It’s amazing to see this event sell out within 24 hours—it's become their biggest fundraiser! This journey has allowed me to blend my marketing skills with my passion for planning.
